en: A vintage divided-back postcard. The front shows a monochrome street scene with ornate late-19th/early-20th‑century villas and shops along a wide avenue. There are trees lining the street, two children with a cart in the foreground, and a horse‑drawn wagon on the right. In the distance is a large decorative building or gate. Printed red captions read "Pécs" and "Schlauch-villatelep". The reverse side has Hungarian printed text, a green 5 filler stamp, a circular postmark, and handwritten Hungarian cursive addressed to Budapest.
